title: City
description: A city that MAY have a page. Existence of a row here does not mean a page exists: Rule 8 requires 3 or more VERIFIED venues, and imported rows never count toward that threshold.

x-notes.no_counts: Rule 2: every count comes from getCounts(scope). This entity deliberately stores NO venue_count, court_count or any other tally. A stored count is a second source of truth and would let a page contradict its own schema, which is exactly the CourtSource failure of 45 vs 46 venues and 185 vs 187 courts.
x-notes.publishability: Whether this city renders a page is computed at build time from verified venue rows. It is never stored here.

slug.description: Rule 10: no numeric duplicate suffixes. Two cities of the same name in one state are disambiguated by county or another real qualifier.

county.description: Derived. Import Gate I3 confidence threshold applies.

aliases.description: Other names locals use. Used for disambiguation and internal search, never to mint a second URL.
